title: feat(spec): a blueprint field carries a typed `defaultValue`, so an AI-built boolean flag defaults to false
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTqqeHSwZYJmApbDCa

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuHuzzmQedufwxyR2BQdPjaR)_

Implemented by the card thread of claim 6668151062 (session_01L6bhgUCEUicLCQ4tkXayK2); round 1 adopted from contract review 6670092320.

Fixes #30584

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` restates a blueprint field key (`skills/objectstack-ai/references/_index.md` only points at `solution-blueprint.zod.ts`); the reference page `content/docs/references/ai/solution-blueprint.mdx` is regenerated from the new describe.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 搭建方案（蓝图）的字段可以写 `defaultValue` 了。宽松 schema 与 strict 结构化输出镜像都加了这个键，并按字段类型校验：布尔取 true/false，数字取数字，单选取本字段自己的选项值；21 种类型可写，其余 28 种写了就按类型名拒收，不再悄悄丢掉；`current_user`、`NOW()` 这类运行时令牌先按令牌拒收，理由说的是令牌，不借用类型的理由（第 1 轮）。
- 为什么改：AI 照搭建指引把「是否完成 / 已付款」写成 `defaultValue: false`，以前解析成功但这个键被剥掉，建出的字段没有默认值，新记录是空而不是「否」，按「否」筛选会漏掉；按 cloud#3619 裁决 B 补上 spec 这一半。
- 风险与回滚：只加不收，之前能解析的蓝图照旧能解析；strict 镜像的生产者每个字段要多发一个 `defaultValue`（无默认填 null）。回滚即还原 `solution-blueprint.zod.ts`、它的测试和台账三处站点，无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts`（准入表 `BLUEPRINT_DEFAULT_VALUE_RULES` 与 `refuseUnfitDefaultValue`）、`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`（末尾 `blueprint field defaultValue` 一节）、`packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`（新增三处站点）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`，预期 97 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`defaultValue` on `BlueprintFieldSchema` and on the strict mirror's fields** (`SolutionBlueprintStrictSchema.objects[].fields[]`, the `StrictField` shape). Both sides declare one scalar union, `boolean | number | string`. Lenient: `.optional()`. Strict: `.nullable()` and present on every field, as with every other key in that mirror; the blueprint tools strip the null. The key is appended last on both sides, so the model generates it after `type` and `options`.
- **The type check lives on the lenient field**, as a `superRefine` (`refuseUnfitDefaultValue`) run with `when: () => true`. It reads one table, `BLUEPRINT_DEFAULT_VALUE_RULES`, typed as a record keyed by every `FieldType` member: a type added to `FieldType` does not compile until it is placed in the table, admitted or refused with a reason. An admitted value is judged by `checkLiteralDefaultValue` from `data/default-value-shape.ts`, the same literal contract `FieldSchema` runs on a built field's `defaultValue` (ADR-0104 D1, `valueSchemaFor(def, 'stored')`). A select / radio default must be one of THIS field's `options[].value`; with no options declared it is refused. A runtime token (`NOW()`, `current_user`) is refused on every type, and it is judged FIRST, before the type's own rule: the refusal gives the token's reason (a blueprint default is a literal), never a refused type's reason, which is false of a token.
- **Every refusal is one `custom` issue at the field's `defaultValue`.** It names the field and its type (`Field "is_done" (boolean): …`), says why, and prescribes the fix. A non-admitted type's refusal lists the types that take a default.
- **Both describes** say the value becomes the built field's `defaultValue`, give the admitted list (built from the table, so describe and refusal read the same list), and state the boolean-flag rule: a 是否完成 / 已付款 / `is_active` flag is a `boolean` field that is never `required` and carries `defaultValue: false`. Each side uses its own spelling of an unset `required` ("omit `required` or set it false" / "`required` null or false").
- **Generated artifacts:** `content/docs/references/ai/solution-blueprint.mdx` (`gen:docs`, two rows), `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ai.json` (one key). `packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gains three hand-edited sites (`ai/BlueprintField` root, `ai/BlueprintObject` `fields.element`, `ai/SolutionBlueprint` `objects.element.fields.element`) and its `droppedRefinementSites` total moves 1020 → 1023: the option-membership rule reads a sibling key, so it has no JSON Schema form.
- **Changeset** `30584-blueprint-field-default-value.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor.

## Tests

A new `describe` block, "blueprint field `defaultValue`", at the end of `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`, 12 cases:

- a boolean with `defaultValue: false` parses and the key survives the parse (own-property check);
- the admitted set is exactly the declared one: every `FieldType` member is tried, the 21 admitted take their value, each of the 28 others is refused with one by-name issue;
- a wrong-typed value on each admitted type is refused, one issue, by name (a string on a boolean, a number on text, `"9am"` on time, a label `"Open"` on a select);
- a select default that is not one of its OWN option values is refused, including a value another field of the same object declares, and a radio with no options;
- a runtime token on an admitted type is refused;
- a runtime token on a type that takes no default (`user` / `lookup` + `current_user`, `date` + `NOW()`, `datetime` + `now()`) is refused with one issue that gives the token's reason, says the type takes no defaultValue in a blueprint and ends `Remove defaultValue from this field.`, and never the type's own reason (round 1);
- an array default on a `multiselect` is refused by name (beside the key's own union issue);
- an absent value parses (lenient); the strict mirror takes null and refuses the key missing, at the key's path;
- the strict mirror accepts what the lenient schema accepts for each admitted type, and null;
- VALUE parity for a key whose rule spans `type`: 49 types × 9 values the strict union accepts; the lenient schema either keeps the value byte-equal or refuses it with exactly one issue that names the type at this key, never strips it;
- every value the blueprint admits is one `FieldSchema` admits on the built field;
- both describes name every admitted type and state the boolean-flag rule.

Seven existing strict fixtures gained `defaultValue: null` (strict mode needs every key), including the leading-digit pin, whose "the only defect left is the leading digit" claim needs it.

## Acceptance notes

- **The strict mirror's shape: `z.union([z.boolean(), z.number(), z.string()]).nullable()`.** Strict structured output states a rule per key and cannot read `type` while it judges this one, so the mirror cannot say which arm a type takes. The per-type check lives on the lenient field, which `apply_blueprint` parses, following the precedent this file already sets for the view filter rule's operator ↔ value refinement. The mirror can therefore generate a value the lenient schema refuses (a string on a boolean), and the cross-product pin holds every such refusal to one by-name issue at the key. The existing identifier VALUE-parity walker does not walk union leaves and is unchanged and green.
- **The lenient key is the same scalar union, not `z.unknown()`** like `FieldSchema.defaultValue`. The published JSON Schema then types the key as the scalars every admitted type draws from, rather than as anything. The price: the union's `invalid_union` aborts before an object refinement runs by default, so the refinement runs with `when: () => true` (the `view.zod.ts` / `analytics-carrier-filter.ts` precedent), and an array or object default gets the union's issue AND the by-name one. A lenient `null` is refused by the union, as on every other lenient key.
- **The admitted types**, grounded in `data/field-value.zod.ts`'s value classes, the ones `valueSchemaFor` answers for a built field's literal default: `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES` (boolean, toggle); `NUMERIC_VALUE_TYPES` minus `summary` (number, currency, percent, rating, slider, progress); `STRING_VALUE_TYPES` minus `password`, `secret`, `signature`, `qrcode` (text, textarea, email, url, phone, markdown, html, richtext, code, color); `CLOCK_TIME_TYPES` (time, `HH:MM[:SS]`, a wall-clock literal that does not age); `SINGLE_OPTION_TYPES` (select, radio), narrowed to the field's own option values (with no options, `valueSchemaFor` would take any string).
- **Refused by name, even where `FieldSchema` takes a default:** `date` / `datetime` (a literal day is frozen at design time; "today" is the `NOW()` token, an instruction rather than a value); `lookup` / `master_detail` / `tree` / `user` and the five file types (the value is the id of a record or file that does not exist while the blueprint is designed; seed data is reported, never applied); `multiselect` / `checkboxes` / `tags` (an array, and this key carries one scalar); `formula` / `summary` / `autonumber` (computed, never read); `password` / `secret` (one credential on every record); `signature` / `qrcode` (made per record); the seven structured JSON types. The brief's example names a `checkbox` type: `FieldType` has none. `checkboxes` is the multi-option type and is refused with the other list types. Widening any of these later is additive; narrowing would be breaking, so the first cut is the narrow one.
- **The boolean-flag sentence** lives in `defaultValue`'s describe on both sides. `required`'s describe is unchanged: no existing key's shape, default or describe moves.
- **Liveness: no row, measured.** `check:liveness` at base `14c67d44` prints 43 governed types (33 authorable plus 10 via `SPEC_ONLY_SCHEMAS`); no blueprint shape is among them, because a blueprint is never persisted and is not a metadata type. The card's Acceptance asks for a `planned` row; that is a deviation with this reading. Carrier for "planned until the cloud half lands": cloud#3619 / cloud#3633 (the build applier that carries the value into the built field and admits the key in its undeclared-key refusal). Once carried, the value is the built field's `defaultValue`, governed by `liveness/field.json` `props.defaultValue` (`live`, `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`).
- **Consumers in this repo:** `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.formula-one-hop.test.ts` reads `BlueprintFieldSchema.shape` and the strict field shape; the refined schema is still a `ZodObject`, and the file is 13/13 after a lint closure build. `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/mapMessages.ts` names `BlueprintFieldSchema` only in a comment: it lifts each field's `name` / `label` from the plan envelope and imports no blueprint schema, so it neither reads nor drops the new key. `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` (input = output for both schemas) is green in the spec suite. The producers and readers that move on the new key (cloud's blueprint tools and build applier) are in objectstack-ai/cloud, outside this repo.
- The ledger's `measured` header also carries `refinementSitesThatDidProject: 369` and `zod: "4.4.3"`, which already differ from what the build prints at base (714, zod 4.6.7). No test reads them; left alone.
- **Round 1** (contract review 6670092320, PASS, one should-fix, adopted by the seat). `refuseUnfitDefaultValue` judged the type before the token, so `{ type: 'user', defaultValue: 'current_user' }` read "no record exists while the blueprint is designed" and `{ type: 'date', defaultValue: 'NOW()' }` read "a literal date is fixed when the blueprint is written", both false of a token. The `isRuntimeDefaultToken` check now runs first for every type in the table. An admitted type keeps its message (`… default is ${rule.takes}; write one, or remove defaultValue.`); a refused type says the value is a runtime token, that a blueprint default is a literal, that the type takes no defaultValue in a blueprint (with the admitted list), and ends `Remove defaultValue from this field.`; `rule.takes` is not read there. Still refused, no token admitted. One new pin; ablation 3 below. `origin/main` merged in (a merge commit, not a rebase). The describe's "carried into the object field" sentence stays as written: it waits on cloud#3633 by the ruled sequencing.
- Branch is the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-7e1clu`, not `claude/issue-30584-*`; claim 6668151062 names it.
